reviews.decision: This finite boundary retains the complete untouched Material16 paginator interfaces and data-source algorithm, rather than inheriting the current Material data source coupled to its paginator. Whole-class/interface AST identity and authentic tagged numeric-recognition body identity are checked. Complete genuine public original/current CDK DataSource and both actual advertised RxJS6.5.3/7.5.5 run the entire original/owned class through the original/owned public legacy facade, preserving parent identity. All 150 observations agree across six subjects: initial streams, trimmed/case/cross-property filtering, numeric/null/unsafe-integer access, stable ascending/descending/disabled sort, delayed/replayed initialization, paging and filtered-page clamps, custom filter/accessor/sort, immutable sort input, detached-control unsubscription and disconnect/reconnect. Twenty effective runtime mutants are rejected. Entire current source/dependency declarations compile at both peer minima and RxJS minima with the repository strictPropertyInitialization:false and skipLibCheck:false; emitted declarations are consumed with fully strict:true. Resolved overloads used by the actual RxJS calls are nondeprecated; unused deprecated overloads do not authorize their use. MatSort active/direction/sortChange/initialized and public DataSource connect/disconnect members resolve as stable public declarations, with public Sort providing the event shape. MatSort/paginator values are explicit stream/property protocols, not actual Angular nodes. All 1140 tracked product bytes, 409 styles and 30 templates are unchanged; the read-only Cyph caller constructs rows and later attaches public sort/paginator. No public API change is needed. Borrowed Node22.23.3/TS6.0.3 does not qualify runtime/compiler floors. Full Angular table/node/AOT/harness/packed declaration and facade integration, whole G11 and independent audit remain open.
